evidence: The crystallinity of the films was investigated by X-ray diffraction (XRD) analyses. The surface morphology of the film was analyzed by scanning electron microscope (SEM). An Oxford ISIS EDX system coupled with the SEM instrument was used for the energy dispersive X-ray (EDX) analysis. The thermal behavior of the rare earth guanidinates was studied by TGA. The fragmentation patterns were analyzed using mass spectrometry (MS). The 1H NMR spectra were recorded to study the molecular structure and decomposition behavior. Infrared (IR) spectroscopy was used to analyze the molecular structure and bonding characteristics. Nuclear Magnetic Resonance (NMR) decomposition studies were performed to assess thermal stability.
